title: ProposedAction
description: An action an agent wants to take, captured before it happens (EA-1.8). The payload stays with the caller; only its hash enters the trust record (EA-6.13).

payload.description: The action itself. Never written to the trust record.

parent_action_id.description: Set when another agent delegated this action (EA-7.2).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds and a Z suffix (EA-6.10).

write_tools.description: Write tools this action will call (EA-1.14).

write_tool_arguments.description: Arguments per write tool, for argument-dependent floors (EA-1.13). Never written to the trust record.
